verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or credentials for an agent, such as role-restricted API keys or permission scopes. The UCP/ACP tokens bound to a checkout session and merchant are tokenized shopper payment credentials, which is an adjacent feature and not agent API credential scoping. The MCP server mention also says nothing about credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
